topic: Type Traits and Pointer Type Traits in C++
explanation: In modern C++, type traits are compile-time templates that provide information about types, enabling template metaprogramming and type-safe generic programming. Specifically, pointer type traits help determine properties of pointer types, such as whether a type is a pointer, a pointer to member, or a null pointer constant. This allows writing generic code that adapts based on type characteristics, improving safety and flexibility.
keywords: Type Traits, std::is_pointer, C++ type information, pointer traits
